name: NTA Majuro datacenter hosting ICANN L-Root instance
developer: Marshall Islands National Telecommunications Authority (NTA) / ICANN
notes: ICANN primary announcement (2017-03-06): L-Root node installed in Majuro; NTA supplied equipment, provided colocation in its datacenter, and bandwidth. This is the only confirmed operational datacenter-class facility in MH (small internet-infrastructure site; MW capacity not disclosed). Page re-verified 2026-08-12.

name: MiNTA/NTA core data center (fiber-to-the-home project)
notes: DCD (2025-09-03): as part of a new fiber-to-the-home project MiNTA is planning 16 Central Offices (11 on Majuro, 5 on Ebeye) plus a new core data center; bids open. Exact site, capacity and build status not disclosed - planned/announced. Re-verified in this pass.

name: Eutelsat OneWeb Satellite Network Portal (Laura, Majuro Atoll)
developer: Eutelsat OneWeb / Marshall Islands National Telecommunications Authority (NTA)
notes: DCD (2025-09-03): NTA signed licensing agreement with Eutelsat to operate a Satellite Network Portal (SNP) for the OneWeb LEO constellation; posted images suggest Laura on Majuro Atoll; expected operational by mid-2026. Satellite gateway/adjacent digital infrastructure, not a conventional colocation datacenter; capacity not disclosed. Re-verified in this pass.

name: IOKWE subsea cable Majuro landing station
developer: Marshall Islands National Telecommunications Authority (owner/operator) via Google Pacific Connect / Halaihai
notes: Planned cable branch infrastructure, not an operational datacenter. Submarine Networks confirms IOKWE lands in Majuro and Ebeye (RMI) as a branch of Google's Halaihai cable; NTA is owner/operator; USG announced ~132M USD funding package (early 2026) and USTDA funded feasibility. Landing-station building is the most plausible future datacenter-adjacent asset - reassess after construction.

name: HANTRU-1 Majuro cable landing station
developer: Marshall Islands National Telecommunications Authority (NTA) / HANTRU1 consortium
notes: Telecom/cable-landing infrastructure, not a commercial colocation datacenter. HANTRU-1 (in service 2010) 2010 extension includes a Majuro landing per TeleGeography/Submarine Cable Map and connectivity reporting; FCC DA-09-1309A1 covers the Kwajalein/Reagan Test Site station terms. One cable system with two MH landings (Majuro + Ebeye/Kwajalein) - recorded per landing station to avoid double-counting the system.
